methods.label: Check whether membership is well-defined
methods.explanation: A set requires its objects to be well-defined. Infinitely many objects can form a set, such as all positive integers. However, “very small” has no clear criterion, so these numbers cannot form a set.
methods.levelReason: The method directly uses the introductory requirement that a set's membership be well-defined.
